A Getnet oferece a antecipação de duas formas, segundo as passagens:

The passages only cover part of this. They explain how to set up the chip, but they don't give a troubleshooting procedure for a terminal with no signal.

- **Check the chip:** Turn the terminal off and open the back cover. Insert the chip in the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal part facing down. Close the cover, turn the terminal on, and wait for it to connect to the data network [1].
- **Confirm the connection:** When the screen shows a connected network (2G or 3G), the terminal is ready to use. Then run a communication test to check that the chip is connecting [1].
- **Turn the terminal off and on:** To turn it on, press the green key. To turn it off, press the "." (dot) key and the yellow key together for 2 seconds. The keys vary by model, so check yours [4].
- **Wi-Fi models:** Getnet has user manuals for the chip and Wi-Fi models. You can download the one for your terminal here: https://site.getnet.com.br/boas-vindas/manual-maquinas/ [2].

No Crediário, o máximo é de até 48 parcelas para o seu cliente [1][3][4]. Esse é o teto do produto. O prazo máximo e os juros dependem do emissor do cartão, porque cada emissor define o limite de parcelas conforme suas políticas de crédito [1][5].

Para ver os juros e as parcelas antes de fechar a venda, faça a simulação na maquininha. Insira o cartão, informe o valor e escolha crédito > crediário [5].

No Crediário, o máximo é de até 48 parcelas por venda. Esse é o teto do produto [prod-crediario-02][prod-crediario-03][prod-crediario-01].

The card issuer can change the interest rates [1], and each issuer sets its own installment limit under its credit policies [3]. You can see the interest your customer will pay by running a simulation on the card machine. Insert the card, enter the amount, then choose credit > crediário [3].
